propositions: Backend-neutral core modules outbound_comments.py and inbound_translate.py load Jira-specific rich-text and comment-limit modules via literal lazy-key strings, causing vendor code execution on neutral paths regardless of configured backend.

Two Jira literal lazy-load keys (_ADF_KEY and _COMMENT_LIMITS_KEY in outbound_comments.py, _ADF_KEY_APPLIER in inbound_translate.py) must be eliminated and routes moved behind port abstraction layers (FieldSanitizer and InboundMapper).

FieldSanitizer gains fit_comment method for pure limit-fitting on the comment-diff path, and InboundMapper gains normalize_rich_text method for backend-neutral rich-text decoding on both inbound apply and outbound diff decode paths.
A test sweep verifies no package-root core module (except recorded inbound_fields.py exemption) contains the literal string 'rebar_reconciler.adapters.jira', enforcing vendor-free core paths.
